purpose: Bundled operator-facing reference for six read-only Status API endpoints and external integrations; not a live availability dashboard.
primaryGoal: Understand authentication, paths, query parameters, transport and sample responses; copy paths and return to system status or request additions.

dataSources.name: Bundled endpoint reference
dataSources.hook: useMemo keyed by t; no status query or EventSource subscription
dataSources.behavior: Six static examples, counts derived from endpoints.length, localized descriptions. Router source mounts all six GET surfaces; nested '/' spelling and actual redirects/HTTP responses were not exercised. The public prefix is documentation, not a request() double-prefix bug.

dataSources.name: Quick-reference and integrations
dataSources.behavior: Four facts and four integration targets. Product names, protocol names, query literals, timestamps and sample incident text are reference examples, not runtime observations.

dataSources.name: Inherited formatting preferences
dataSources.behavior: Shared settings query key ['settings'], five-minute staleTime, refetchOnMount='always', retry=1, default preferences and broadcast-driven refetch. Page has no direct status fetching, but the rendered summary subscribes to a settings query. Actual network traffic and query deduplication are unverified.

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.reuse: Keep existing shell/header adapter and full-width min-w-0 content.

components.name: SystemSummaryBrief / OperationalBrief
components.reuse: Four summary metrics plus Review details drawer, decision narrative, provenance, limitations and attention fallback.

components.name: StatusApiEndpointCard
components.reuse: Reuse six times; keep path copying, optional query and guarded serialized example disclosure.

components.name: GlassPanel / Button / Badge / Typography
components.reuse: Neutral surface owner already exists; no new card or typography engine needed.

components.name: KVList
components.reuse: Use existing responsive definition-list layout rather than inventing a facts grid.

components.name: CopyButton / Accordion
components.reuse: Existing clipboard and disclosure APIs; no replacement clipboard or accordion implementation.

components.name: InlineCallout
components.reuse: Preserve additive-compatibility warning and native issue link.

components.name: FadeIn
components.reuse: Four entry groups; shared motion preference controls reduced entrance motion.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Six endpoint references already share one renderer; no confirmed competing endpoint implementation in this bounded scope.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Retain the existing StatusApiEndpointCard; do not duplicate six custom panels.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Integration row surfaces and icon chips hand-compose surface/ring colors four times through one map, outside neutral surface tokens.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep the local mapped list; switch its classes to existing surface/border/text tokens. A new shared integration card is not justified by a second independent consumer.

sourceStrategy: Overview/integrations stack until xl and then use a 2:1 three-column split
Endpoint path/query break-all; example pre has max-h-72 and local overflow-auto
Compact OperationalBrief uses 1/2/3/6 metric columns by breakpoint

issues.detail: KVList is called without layout or wrap, selecting its inline nonwrapping flex layout. Long authentication values and translated labels can compete for narrow width.
issues.fix: Pass layout='responsive' using its existing allocated-container wrapping behavior; retain all four facts.

issues.detail: Integration name and explanatory caption use truncate without an alternate full-text disclosure; narrow/long-localized captions may lose visible information.
issues.fix: Wrap both texts and let rows grow instead of hiding integration guidance.

issues.detail: Footer callout has a shrink-0 action label and a flex-1 body in a nonwrapping inline-flex row; long translated action labels can squeeze or overflow the prose.
issues.fix: Shared callout should reflow its action at narrow allocated width without hiding prose or changing native link semantics.

sourceStrengths: Localized page title and endpoint section label
Overview/integration icons and endpoint decorative glyphs hidden from assistive technology
Accordion useId relationships, aria-expanded, labelled region and Button trigger
Shared forced-color panel borders and reduced-motion handling

issues.detail: CopyButton uses size='sm', inheriting h-9 (36px); page back and brief Review details also use sm. This is below the contract's stronger 44px mobile default, though WCAG spacing exceptions may apply.
issues.fix: Use existing Button/CopyButton className to provide at least 44px mobile targets and preserve compact desktop sizing; measure actual target spacing.

issues.detail: Back button has a fixed small height without wrapLabel; long localized text may not fit allocated header width.
issues.fix: Enable existing wrapLabel and validate header layout with long labels while retaining /system-status destination.

states.initialLoading: Bundled docs need no status-source loading spinner. Inherited settings can load with defaults; summary is supplied available=true and is not a runtime health assertion.
states.empty: Static six-endpoint reference is populated. Individual card empty example renders localized placeholder, never replaces all page content.
states.error: JSON serialization failures are caught per card and render localized unavailable example. No status network-error state applies to this page.
states.partial: Examples, facts, integrations and footer are independent and always remain rendered.
states.staleOffline: Bundled docs are not live snapshots. Their source scope says so. Inherited settings state is not presented as docs health; no measured-zero substitution should be introduced.
states.success: CopyButton swaps Copy icon to check for two seconds. Explicit ariaLabel remains the path-specific name; actual live announcement behavior is unverified.
states.disabled: No page mutation/loading disable state; CopyButton supports disabled but page does not supply it.

issues.detail: CopyButton is invoked without withToast or onCopyError. Shared failure path logs and clears copied state, but this caller provides no visible clipboard failure/manual-copy recovery.
issues.fix: Use existing withToast and onCopyError props with localized manual-copy guidance while leaving path text selectable.

issues.rule: MDC-026 source trust / mission 43 reduced noise
issues.detail: Bundled documentation is wrapped in System evidence/Source available plus Source observation time not supplied, and a generic decision-narrative drawer with absent impact/cause/recommendation. This is source-truthful but implies operational evidence for static docs and adds repeated unknown metadata.
issues.fix: Provide documentation-specific statusLabel/freshness through existing adapter props; coordinate any optional static-document narrative mode with shared owners. Preserve four metrics and every current detail/provenance/limitation capability until equivalence is demonstrated.

visualIssues.detail: Integration rows use fixed white translucent surfaces/rings plus cyan chips; factual code/icons also use text-cyan-300 at lines 165,227,247. These ignore theme-neutral surface/text hierarchy and use accent for nonsemantic metadata.
visualIssues.fix: Use current neutral surface/border/text tokens; reserve semantic accent for meaningful interactive or status cues. Validate both light/dark contrast rather than assume toned-down cyan passes.

visualIssues.detail: Read-only reference panels opt into hover glow='cyan', cyan icons and cyan path text. GlassPanel implements this as cyan border tint/elevation, not literal glowing text; still decorative emphasis competes with actual Copy/disclosure actions.
visualIssues.fix: Keep canonical neutral GlassPanel with hover disabled or neutral; use neutral code text and focus emphasis on actual controls.

visualIssues.detail: Example disclosures inherit border-white/[0.06], hover:bg-white/[0.02], fixed cyan focus ring and border-white/[0.04] body separator at line 130; forced-colors support exists but ordinary themes retain dark-biased chrome.
visualIssues.fix: Centralize neutral border/control/focus token treatment in existing Accordion without altering controlled/uncontrolled behavior, IDs, open state or motion preferences.

visualIssues.detail: Additive-compatibility policy uses warning styling despite not describing a current fault or required intervention.
visualIssues.fix: Consider informational/neutral emphasis using existing callout variants, retaining the complete compatibility statement.

architectureIssues.detail: Comment says no backend round-trip, but SystemSummaryBrief's format bridge reaches shared settings GET. The six documented status endpoints are not fetched.
architectureIssues.fix: Clarify static status-reference content versus inherited preference subscriptions; retain settings/query policy rather than creating another preference store.

architectureIssues.detail: Inherited settings query uses getSettings directly; getSettings has no signal argument and calls request('/settings') without cancellation. Existing canonical API hook already forwards signal, but replacing policies casually could change behavior.
architectureIssues.fix: Shared integration owner should add cancellation to the existing settings query path while retaining query key, defaults, five-minute stale policy, mount revalidation, retry and broadcasts; page must not fork this logic.

architectureIssues.detail: Overview says every response is JSON over HTTP and facts advertise application/json universally, while /status/live explicitly sets text/event-stream (v1.go:355). Status payload data is JSON inside SSE framing, not a JSON HTTP response.
architectureIssues.fix: Document JSON for REST and text/event-stream for SSE; preserve live path, event names, 30s default push, 25s heartbeat and curl flags.

architectureIssues.detail: Incidents description says Active incidents list, but mounted List only enables active filtering when active=1/true; unfiltered path is not explicitly active-only (incidents.go:57-63).
architectureIssues.fix: Clarify default versus active=1 behavior against the handler, without assuming repository ordering, limit defaults or HTTP behavior not inspected.

architectureIssues.detail: Overall example omits the components array defined in StatusSnapshot and optional maintenance despite its descriptive claim. It is a static illustration, not necessarily a complete schema; sample version timestamps are intentionally fictional.
architectureIssues.fix: Label examples illustrative or show source-confirmed fields; retain descriptions and all sample details. Do not fabricate live measurements or upgrade current_snapshot uptime into historical availability.

priority.rationale: Static read-only page already uses shared layout, typography and endpoint cards. Prioritize documentation truth, copy recovery and narrow-width full-text reachability, then neutral presentation and inherited shared chrome. No page source change belongs to Phase0.
order: Clarify REST/SSE and active filter contract
Preserve complete text/copy recovery at narrow width

requiredSharedChanges.name: Neutral disclosure chrome
props: Retain title, description, defaultOpen, open/onOpenChange, icon, badge, headerExtra, headerClassName, bodyClassName and className; no new disclosure engine
variants: Existing neutral ghost trigger with tokenized border/hover/focus
dependsOn: Accordion owner focused tests and centralized browser acceptance
requiredSharedChanges.scopeLimit: Other independent production consumers were not enumerated; shared owner must assess blast radius.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Callout action reflow and canonical typography
props: Retain variant, icon, children, action:{label,href?,onClick?}, className, testId
requiredSharedChanges.scopeLimit: Use source-confirmed callout extension, not a page-local clone. A second independent page consumer was not inspected.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Settings query cancellation
props: Forward queryFn context signal through getSettings/request options; retain public settings result contract
requiredSharedChanges.scopeLimit: Integration/shared ownership only; no Phase0 implementation.

competingImplementations.finding: One local StatusApiEndpointCard already owns repeated reference rendering; no second implementation confirmed.

useSettings app-level hook and api/hooks/useSettings both read /settings; the summary uses the app-level path. Cancellation differs. This is existing ownership overlap, not authorization for a page-local replacement.
Existing PageLayout -> PageContainer, GlassPanel and OperationalBrief pipeline are canonical; no new wrapper/palette/stat engine needed.

preservation.hashAlgorithm: SHA-256 of current raw page bytes

sections.name: API surface summary

sections.name: Overview

sections.name: Designed for

actions.name: Copy endpoint path
actions.behavior: Copies exact public path, not optional query string; shared two-second success state

actions.name: Expand/collapse example response
actions.behavior: Initially collapsed independent Accordion; full indented sample JSON with local scrolling; serialization/empty placeholders

actions.name: Review details / close details
actions.behavior: Drawer receives description, status, narrative/provenance/limitations, all four metrics and attention fallback; onClose resets open state at line 236

actions.name: Open an issue
actions.behavior: Native anchor supplied by InlineCallout; no target=_blank override

dataBehavior: Keep six GET documented endpoints in current order and all examples/descriptions/icons; no backend mutation actions are presented.
Retain uptime window choices 24h/7d/30d/90d/1y, current_snapshot provenance and planned-history caveat.
Retain incidents active=1/limit=N guidance, update timeline sample, source/components/severity and timestamps.
Retain live SSE status framing, heartbeat explanation, EventSource and curl -N --no-buffer guidance; SSE example is illustrative JSON containing a note, not an actual SSE connection.
Keep counts derived from endpoint array, typed domain-card props, translation memo dependencies and usePageTitle.
Retain user formatting/preferences and query policy; never convert static illustration values into live measurements or fabricate healthy state.
No local date/vehicle controls are present or required for static documentation.
No user-configurable table/export/filter/source calculations are present; no capability may be added by assumption.

evidenceLimits.mode: Atomic Phase0 source-only audit; source, routes and dependencies read without edits.
evidenceLimits.backend: Read router plus status response structs/handlers only. No HTTP/SSE/auth exercise. Incident repository details, authorization-header acceptance, reverse-proxy deployment and rate-limit behavior unverified.
notRun: audit.sh (contains project-wide TypeScript; source-only counts used instead)

sourceOnlyChecks.command: PowerShell Get-Content line counts for page, StatusApiEndpointCard and SystemSummaryBrief
PowerShell regex counts on page and StatusApiEndpointCard: style={{; raw button/input/textarea/select/table; direct recharts/react-leaflet/framer-motion; old ../api/../../api; text-neon-
sourceOnlyChecks.output: Each of five patterns: page=0; card=0. This bounded scan is not a full violations or i18n acceptance result.

evidenceLimits.coverage: Assigned page plus bounded page-specific presentation/preferences and shared component implementation inspection. No whole-app consumer census, full import graph or shared ownership blast-radius certification.
evidenceLimits.snapshotCaveat: Citations refer to current inspected source; other workers may change dependencies. Page hash is rechecked at release.
